name: subsquare-mcp
description: A Streamable HTTP MCP server for querying SubSquare Gov2 referenda through its API.

scripts.no-proxy-start: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy node --env-file-if-exists=.env src/index.js
scripts.no-proxy-inspect: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy mcp-inspector --web --transport http --server-url ${MCP_SERVER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3210/mcp}
